source_snapshot.procedure: Generic setup says clear logs; open Dashboard and Server Health > Sensor Reading.
source_snapshot.criteria: Sensor reading and threshold are human readable and match specification.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES reads the named sensor but uses exposed credentials, assumes cipher 17 and truncates fallback inventory; it cannot prove physical motherboard-outlet identity, complete fields, UI correlation, reference conditions or specification compliance.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION requires outlet location, airflow/reference context, complete SDR/UI fields and no fan, threshold or log mutation.

old_problem: A plausible temperature or successful literal query could be accepted without proving that the record represents the motherboard outlet sensing point. The prior command also omitted a co-located reference, operating/airflow state, complete non-truncated sensor metadata, both UI mappings and an authoritative tolerance, so room ambient or a different exhaust point could create a false PASS.
disposition_reason: The passive outlet-sensor purpose, UI paths and read-only method are clear. Bind the exact physical outlet point to one stable sensor and both UI rows, capture complete value/threshold/status/freshness data and compare it with a co-located calibrated reference under recorded passive load, fan and airflow conditions. The platform-specific location and acceptance values are Project inputs rather than a reason to retain an Engineering Decision Pending state.
decision_basis: XLSX row 876, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, internal Script reference, selection manifest and historical record were directly reviewed.
Motherboard outlet air, room ambient, board inlet, chassis exhaust and PSU exhaust are distinct measurands; a label or plausible value cannot establish physical identity.

A passive read-only comparison can be fully specified with a stable sensor/UI map, co-located calibrated reference, recorded airflow/load state and Project-approved tolerance without authorizing a thermal stimulus.
ED-15 prohibits PASS without an approved tolerance, ED-17 rejects pre-clear, and ED-20 preserves this outlet point as its own coverage rather than substituting another temperature sensor.

test_case.test_name: Verify TEMP_MB_OUTLET against the physical motherboard outlet point and platform thermal specification
test_case.purpose: Verify TEMP_MB_OUTLET is the correct physical motherboard outlet-air sensor and that Dashboard and Server Health independently show its human-readable Celsius value, units, health, implemented thresholds/hysteresis and freshness in agreement with the platform specification and a co-located reference at the recorded passive operating state.
required_package: Exact chassis/board/BMC/BIOS configuration and board sensor-placement/airflow drawing identifying the TEMP_MB_OUTLET sensing point
Stable SDR/API name, number, type, entity/instance and corresponding Dashboard and Server Health rows
Celsius scaling/rounding, approved value or reference delta, combined uncertainty, threshold capability/values/hysteresis, health and unavailable rules
Calibrated reference instrument, valid calibration, approved probe position at the motherboard outlet plane, sample window and BMC update-lag rule
Recorded power/load state, inlet condition, fan policy/speeds, panel/duct configuration, airflow direction and timestamp alignment
Validated protected OOB/API/browser clients and pinned immutable reviewed `sensor.git` revision/checksum or approved manual read-only method
test_case.test_command: Do not clear logs, change fan policy, add load or heat, obstruct airflow, move panels/ducts or write thresholds. Confirm the physical motherboard outlet point from the board/airflow definition and place the calibrated reference at the approved co-located outlet position without disturbing flow. Resolve one stable TEMP_MB_OUTLET identity from the complete sensor repository; review the Script before use. Capture its complete value, units, capability/threshold/hysteresis, health and timestamp plus unchanged Dashboard and Server Health rows. Record fan/load/power/inlet/airflow state, align reference and BMC samples within the approved lag window and compare them using the approved combined tolerance. Stop without retry on missing, duplicate, stale or divergent identity.
test_case.expected_result: One stable sensor and both UI rows map to the documented motherboard outlet sensing point. Complete OOB/UI values, units, threshold capability/values, health and freshness agree with the specification, and the time-aligned reading agrees with the co-located reference within the approved combined tolerance under the recorded passive airflow/load state. No inlet, room-ambient, chassis-exhaust or PSU-exhaust reading substitutes and no state is mutated.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires physical outlet mapping, complete OOB and both-UI agreement, an approved reference position/timing/uncertainty model and engineer verdict that every applicable field and outlet delta meet specification. A readable/plausible value, label-only match, room ambient, another exhaust point, truncated output or command success alone cannot pass. Wrong/duplicate identity, stale data, out-of-tolerance value, required field/threshold/status mismatch or UI divergence is FAIL. Missing location/spec/reference/tolerance/reviewed method is NOT READY, not Pending or PASS; dynamic thermal response is not covered.
safety_gate: Do not clear SEL or system logs; thermal and fan history is relevant evidence.
Do not infer outlet placement from the label or substitute room ambient, inlet, chassis-exhaust, PSU-exhaust or CPU-package telemetry.
Do not alter fan/load/airflow/environment or thresholds and do not inject a thermal event.
Position the reference without obstructing the outlet; include calibration, spatial gradient, timing, sensor lag and combined uncertainty in the approved tolerance.
Honor threshold capability masks and preserve identity, units, status and timestamps; unsupported thresholds require specification proof.
Do not truncate inventory, expose credentials or run an unreviewed Script; preserve first evidence and do not retry automatically.
expected_evidence: Chassis/board/BMC/BIOS identity, cooling configuration and diagram/photo locating the precise outlet sensor and reference positions
Complete stable raw identity, value, units, threshold capabilities/values/hysteresis, health and timestamp
Separate unchanged Dashboard and Server Health evidence mapped to the same sensor
Calibrated co-located reference samples plus fan/load/power/inlet/airflow state and timestamp alignment
Project value/threshold/status/freshness specification and combined uncertainty/update-lag calculation
Missing/duplicate/stale/divergent disposition, pinned Script or alternate-method audit, no-clear/no-write/no-stimulus/no-retry proof and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: No mutation is expected. On mapping ambiguity, stale or divergent data, unexpected health change or reference-placement disturbance, stop and preserve the first complete evidence and airflow state. Remove only the non-invasive reference fixture if authorized, then use approved BMC/board diagnostics; restore any independently authorized configuration change through the platform owner rather than this case.

source_conflict.reason: Items, Dashboard/Server Health Procedure and readability/specification Criteria consistently describe one passive motherboard-outlet sensor check. Missing placement and acceptance inputs do not create a source-purpose conflict.

blocked.reason: The target and passive verification method are clear. Physical location, reference placement and acceptance limits are supplyable Project configuration inputs.
